choices.reason: Neither candidate is designated primary/main, and the abstract and introduction emphasize moderated mediation without selecting an adjusted or unadjusted total-effect specification. Rule 2's no-added-controls fallback therefore selects the unadjusted randomized post-test contrast; the alternative ANCOVA controls for pre-test creativity and demographics.
choices.locator: PDF p. 5 (printed p. 99), Section 4, first ANCOVA sentence (quoted); PDF pp. 1-2 (printed pp. 95-96), Abstract and Introduction, for the absence of a specification preference; PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Table 2, unadjusted Post-test columns.
choices.quote: To test Hypothesis 1, we conducted an ANCOVA examining the effect of AI assistance on post-test creativity scores, controlling for pre-test creativity, age, work experience, gender, and race.
